steps.prompt: Two trains $300$ km apart head towards each other at $70$ km/h and $80$ km/h. How long until they meet? How fast is the gap between them shrinking?
steps.placeholder: The gap shrinks at… They meet after…

cards.title: Distance = rate × time
cards.body: $d = rt$, so $t = \frac{d}{r}$ and $r = \frac{d}{t}$. Keep the units matched: km/h with hours, m/s with seconds. When two things move towards each other, the gap closes at the SUM of their speeds. When one chases the other, it closes at the DIFFERENCE.

cards.title: Worked example: meeting trains
cards.problem: Two trains $300$ km apart head towards each other at $70$ km/h and $80$ km/h. After how many hours do they meet?

steps.text: Each hour the gap closes by $70 + 80 = 150$ km.
The gap is $300$ km, so they meet after $\frac{300}{150}$ hours.

cards.title: Make a table
cards.body: For each part of a trip, write a row: rate, time, distance. Then look for what is equal: the same distance there and back, the same time if they start and stop together, or distances that add up to the whole trip. That equal thing is your equation.

cards.title: Worked example: late and early
cards.problem: Walking at $4$ km/h, Ana gets to school $10$ minutes late. At $6$ km/h she is $5$ minutes early. How far is school?

steps.text: Call the distance $d$. The slow walk takes $\frac{d}{4}$ hours and the fast walk $\frac{d}{6}$ hours.
The two times differ by $10 + 5 = 15$ minutes. Change that to hours.
So $\frac{d}{4} - \frac{d}{6} = \frac{1}{4}$. The left side is $\frac{d}{12}$, so $d = 3$ km.

try.prompt: How far is school, in km?

cards.title: The common trap: minutes and hours
cards.body: $15$ minutes is $\frac{1}{4}$ of an hour, not $0.15$. Change every time to the same unit before you write the equation. And remember from Unit 2: average speed is total distance over total time, not the average of the speeds.

prompts: When do speeds add, and when do they subtract? Give an example of each.
